_doc: Agent drip senders — locked spec: briefs/BRIEF_SECONDARY_SENDING_DOMAIN_2026-08-25.md ('Standing architecture' + 'Warm-up plan').
Two domains, asymmetric roles. workhorse = carries the drip, ramps to the list-sized steady state. understudy = small, warm segment, reputation insurance.

ramp = the per-step daily cap ladder. The engine advances ONE step at a time and only through the gates in scripts/campaign-senders.mjs (healthy days at the step, bounces <2%, no failures/pause, replies still arriving, never more than 2x week-over-week). The ladder is never a calendar.
ceiling = list-sized steady state; raise it when Ryan adds contacts (volume follows the list, never the reverse). The ramp stops at min(ramp step, ceiling).

segment: 'drip' = the pool nobody else claims; 'relationships' = campaign contacts whose email is in the Relationships table (tiers below). A contact stays on whichever sender sent its last touch (thread continuity).
replyTo: header on every send. Default info@lrghomes.com (existing watched campaign inbox) until Ryan answers Q2 in briefs/REBUILD_PROGRESS_2026-09.md. null = no Reply-To.

CAMPAIGN_SENDERS env (comma list of addresses) narrows the enabled set at runtime; unset = every sender with enabled:true. CAMPAIGN_SEND_AS is only a legacy fallback when this file has no enabled sender.
